sloka: बहुश्रुतानां वृद्धानां ब्राह्मणानामुपासिता ।तेना स्येहातुला कीर्तिर्यशस्तेजश्च वर्धते ॥२-२-३३॥
transliteration: bahuśrutānāṁ vṛddhānāṁ brāhmaṇānāmupāsitā ।tenā syehātulā kīrtiryaśastejaśca vardhate ॥2-2-33॥

translations.english: This son of the Raghus (Rama) is softspoken, steadfast, always serene, truthful and free from envy. He is pleasing to all beings. He serves those elderly brahmins versed in many lores. With these virtues his incomparable glory, fame and splendour have steadily grown.
